verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is a consumer 2FA app, and in-app AI-generated insights or suggestions (for example, security recommendations about stored accounts) are a plausible capability for that kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. The features documented are code management, import/export, sharing, notes, backups and search, and the llms.txt probe is site documentation for AI crawlers, not an in-product feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
